chunks: Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah narrates, raising the chain from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, who said:
I said to Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (peace be upon him): 'By what do I establish the tawhid of God?'

So he said: 'O Yunus! Do not become an innovator. Whoever views (religion) by his own opinion perishes, and whoever abandons the People of the Household of his Prophet (may God bless him and his family) goes astray, and whoever abandons the Book of God and the words of His Prophet commits kufr.'

key_terms.أَهْلَ بَيْتِ: the People of the Household (Ahl al-Bayt) — the Prophet's family as divinely authorised guides
key_terms.أُوَحِّدُ: affirm divine unity, establish tawhid — the central question of monotheistic methodology
key_terms.بِرَأْيِهِ: by one's own opinion — unsanctioned personal reasoning divorced from revealed guidance
key_terms.مُبْتَدِعًا: innovator in religion, one who introduces forbidden novelty (bid'ah) unsanctioned by revelation

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) teach about how to establish tawhid and the consequences of abandoning the Ahl al-Bayt or the Quran?
ai.summary: Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman asks Imam Musa al-Kazim (AS) about the correct methodology for establishing tawhid. The Imam issues a three-part warning — reliance on personal opinion leads to destruction, abandoning the Ahl al-Bayt leads to straying, and abandoning the Quran and Prophetic tradition constitutes kufr — establishing that authentic tawhid requires all three sources in concert.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Abu Abdullah, raising it from Yunus Bin Abdul Rahman who said,
‘I said to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> the 1<sup>st</sup>, ‘How can I (establish) the Oneness of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>?’

So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Yunus! Do not become an innovator. The one who views by his own opinion would be destroyed, and the one who neglects the People<sup>asws</sup> of the Household of His<sup>azwj</sup> Prophet<sup>saww</sup> would stray, and the one who neglects the Book of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and the words of His<sup>azwj</sup> Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, would blaspheme’.
en.sarwar: 10. Muhammad ibn abu ‘Abdallah has narrated in a marfu’ manner from Yunus ibn ’Abd al-Rahman who has said the following.
“I asked (Imam) abu al-Hassan the First, ‘How would I prove that Allah is one?’”

The Imam replied, “O Yunus, do not be an innovator. One who depends on his personal opinion he is destroyed. One who abandons the members of the family of his prophet, goes stray. Whoever abandons the book of Allah and the words of His prophet he becomes an unbeliever.”
